description: Lexman is joined by Dmitri Dolgov, a microbiologist and associate professor at the University of Chicago, to discuss his work on developing a robot arm to disinfect medical implants. They discuss the various botels and antisepsis devices that Dolgov has developed, their benefits, and the hurdles they still face in terms of widespread adoption.
classificationReason: Primarily discusses developing a robot arm and related devices for disinfecting medical implants.
qualityReason: Named academic guest and discussion of technical development, benefits, adoption hurdles, and devices indicate a substantive interview.
